turns.text: So... (a) deposit wala civil hai kyunki paisa-len-den ka mamla hai, aur (c) virasat wala bhi civil — property dispute. Phir (b) phone chheenna criminal hai, chori type, aur (d) car-takkar bhi criminal, hit and run. Toh civil: a aur c; criminal: b aur d. Sahi kiya?

Haan, sahi: deposit aur virasat ke jhagde civil hain; phone chheenna aur car-takkar wale offences criminal. Ab ek wajah sochiye: criminal case mein sirf peedit ke bajay state bhi case court mein kyon le jaata hai?
Arey matlab... peedit toh dar gaya hoga, hospital mein hoga ya police ke paas jaane se darta hai. Toh state uski help karne ke liye case leta hai, victim weak hai na isliye. Sahi hai?

Aap keh rahe hain ki peedit dara ya hospital mein ho sakta hai, isliye state case leti hai. Lekin peedit bilkul taiyaar ho, tab bhi phone chheenna kanoon ke khilaaf offence hai, sirf do logon ka jhagda nahi; isliye state bhi case chalati hai. Ab judiciary ka ek aur kaam dekhein: court kisi kanoon ko Samvidhaan se milaakar jaanchta hai. Is shakti ko kya kehte hain?
Woh... kanoon check karne wali power? 'Law review' hota hai kya? Jaise court dekhta hai ki law sahi hai ya nahi?
Is power ka naam judicial review hai; yahan 'sahi' ka matlab hai Samvidhaan ke mutabik hai ya nahi. Maan lijiye ek kanoon mahilaon ko sarkaari naukri se rokta hai; court kya jaanchega, aur kyon?

Dekho na, court toh bade-bade lawyers wali jagah hai. Aam aadmi, jaise koi gareeb mahila, vo itna afford nahi kar sakti court aur itne bade case ki fees. Toh Supreme Court mein jaake kaise case karegi? Aur yeh kaanoon mahilaon ke liye hai, toh shayad koi sunega bhi nahi. Pata nahi, court kuch nahi karega shayad, bas aise hi kaanoon chalega?

Aapko lag raha hai ki fees na de paane par gareeb mahila ki baat court tak pahunchegi hi nahi. Par agar koi paisa na hone ke bawajood court tak pahunch sake, toh kya court us kanoon ko bina jaanche chalne dega? Muft kanooni madad mil sakti hai; court jaanch sakta hai ki mahilaon par yeh rok Samvidhaan ke barabar adhikaar ke khilaaf toh nahi. Pehla chhota sawaal: muft kanooni madad ka matlab kya hoga?

Muft kanooni madad matlab free lawyer, jo paise nahi lete? Par aise cases toh sirf ameer log hi court le jaate hain na, gareeb mahila toh soch bhi nahi sakti court jaane ki. Supreme Court mein toh aur bada kharcha hoga, toh shayad court kuch nahi karega, bas kaanoon chalega aise hi?

Aap pooch rahe hain ki free lawyer ke baad bhi court jaana kaise mumkin hoga. Muft kanooni madad mein lawyer ki madad bina fees mil sakti hai; isliye paise ki kami se kanoon ki jaanch rukni zaroori nahi. Ab chhota kadam: mahilaon ko sarkaari naukri se rokne wale kanoon ko court kis cheez se milaakar jaanchega?

Samvidhaan se? Lekin mahila gareeb hai toh Supreme Court kaise jayegi? Fees, lawyer ka kharcha — itna paisa nahi hai uske paas. Toh court shayad kuch nahi karega, bas kaanoon chalega. Pata nahi, yeh sab sirf ameer logon ke liye hai na?

Court kanoon ko Samvidhaan se milaata hai. Aapko lag raha hai ki gareeb mahila fees aur lawyer ka kharcha nahi utha paayegi, toh kanoon ki jaanch hi nahi hogi. Par muft kanooni madad mein lawyer ka kharcha us par nahi padta; ab patthar khadaan ke mazdoor khud court na jaa sakein aur koi unke liye Supreme Court ko chitthi likhe, toh yeh kis tarah ka raasta hai?

Chitthi se case? Aise thodi hota hai, court mein toh lawyer chahiye na, fees bhi lagti hai. Pata nahi, shayad allowed hi nahi hoga, gareeb logon ke liye court nahi hai. Case kaise ban sakta hai chitthi se?

Aap keh rahe hain ki lawyer aur fees ke bina chitthi se case nahi ban sakta. Lekin in mazdooron ke liye koi aur Supreme Court ko chitthi likhe, toh court use jan-hit ki arzi, ya PIL, ke roop mein le sakta hai; mazdooron ka khud lawyer lekar pahunchna zaroori nahi. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki har chitthi case ban jaati hai. Is misaal mein unke liye court tak baat kaun pahuncha sakta hai?

Chitthi se toh case nahi ho sakta. Court mein jaana padta hai, lawyer chahiye, fees lagti hai. Ye mazdoor gareeb hain, toh unka case kaise chalega? Shayad koi allowed nahi hoga, matlab chitthi se kuch nahi hoga. Pata nahi, ye sab sirf ameer logon ke liye hai.

Aapko lagta hai ki mazdooron ke paas lawyer aur fees nahi, isliye chitthi ka koi asar nahi hoga. Sochiye: jab woh khud court nahi ja sakte, koi aur unki bandhua mazdoori ki baat Supreme Court tak pahunchata hai; court aisi chitthi ko PIL ke roop mein le sakta hai. PIL ka matlab jan-hit mein arzi. Is case mein mazdoor khud court na jaa paayein, toh unki baat kaun pahunchata hai?
pata nahi… mujhe nahi aata yeh

Koi baat nahi, aapko abhi naam yaad nahi aa raha. Ek chhota step lete hain: mazdoor khud nahi jaa sakte, lekin koi aur unki taraf se court ko chitthi likhta hai. Chitthi kiski taraf se likhi gayi hai?

Chitthi matlab kisi aur ne likhi hai mazdooron ki taraf se? Lekin aise thodi case banta hai, court mein toh khud jaana padta hai na, lawyer aur fees ke saath. Gareeb mazdooron ka kya hoga, unka case kaise chalega? Pata nahi, shayad allowed hi nahi hai, aise chitthi se kuch nahi hota. Case nahi ban sakta.

Haan, chitthi kisi aur ne mazdooron ki taraf se likhi hai. Aapko lag raha hai ki khud court na jaayein aur lawyer ki fees na dein, toh case ban hi nahi sakta. Bandhua mazdoori jaise maamle mein Supreme Court us chitthi ko PIL ke roop mein le sakta hai; isliye unki baat sunne ka raasta hai. Pehla kadam kisne liya, mazdooron ne ya chitthi likhne wale ne?

Chitthi likhne wale ne? Par yaar, aise thodi case banta hai... court mein toh khud jaana padta hai, lawyer aur fees bhi chahiye. Gareeb mazdooron ka kya, unke paas toh kuch nahi hai. Poora system hi aisa hai, sirf ameer logon ke liye. Pata nahi, chitthi se kuch nahi hoga, case allowed nahi hoga.

Chitthi kisi aur ne mazdooron ki taraf se likhi. Aapko lag raha hai ki fees aur lawyer na hon, toh court unki baat sun hi nahi sakta; lekin bandhua mazdoori ke is maamle mein Supreme Court us chitthi ko PIL maan kar sun sakta hai. Matlab mazdoor khud na pahunch paayein, phir bhi unki baat court tak ja sakti hai. Chitthi mein mazdooron ki dikkat court ko kaun bata raha hai?

Chitthi mein dikkat bata raha hai? Pata nahi... lekin case toh nahi ban sakta aise. Court mein lawyer chahiye, fees chahiye, aur gareeb mazdoor toh khud ja hi nahi sakte. Shayad allowed hi nahi hai, sirf ameer logon ke liye court hai.

Chitthi mein mazdooron ki dikkat bataayi gayi hai. Aap soch rahe hain ki fees na ho toh court sunega hi nahi; par sochiye, khadaan ke mazdoor khud nahi pahunch sakte, aur koi aur unke liye darwaaza khatkhatata hai. Supreme Court bandhua mazdoori ki aisi chitthi ko PIL maan sakta hai. Agar mazdoor khud court nahi ja sakte, toh unki baat court tak kaun pahuncha raha hai?
